Field.Label: HoneywellEnvisalink — connect Honeywell Vista panels to Indigo via Envisalink modules.
⚠ BETA SOFTWARE (v0.1.0) — has not been tested against real Honeywell hardware. Leave "Test mode" ON until you have verified state-reading works. Report any issues on the Indigo forum (user: CliveS).
If you keep secrets in /Library/Application Support/Perceptive Automation/IndigoSecrets.py, set ENVISALINK_PASSWORD there and it will be used in preference to the value above.
Test mode (SAFE):
Field.Description: When ON, the plugin reads state from the panel and updates Indigo devices, but BLOCKS all arm/disarm/bypass commands from being sent. Recommended on first install — disable only when you've verified state reading works correctly.

Field.Label: Verbose protocol logging:
Field.Description: Logs every raw TPI line sent and received (user codes redacted). Useful for diagnosing connection or panel-compatibility issues. Generates a lot of log output — leave off in normal operation.

Field.Label: General debug logging:
Field.Description: Logs frame-dispatch decisions and other internal events.
